question: In which of the following states of India does the ‘Sonepur Cattle Fair’ take place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sonepur Cattle Fair** is an annual event that takes place in **Bihar, India.**
 
• It is also known as the **Harihar Kshetra Mela **and is one of the **biggest cattle fairs** in Asia.
 
• The fair is held on the banks of the **River Ganges** in the town of Sonepur, located in the **Saran district of Bihar**.
 
• The fair attracts thousands of visitors from across India and the world, who come to witness the sale and purchase of various animals like** horses, cows, buffaloes, goats, and camels.**
 
• Apart from the **livestock trade**, the fair also offers a range of entertainment options like **acrobats, magicians, and traditional folk performances.**
 
• The Sonepur Cattle Fair is a significant cultural event in Bihar and is an important platform for **farmers, traders, and animal lovers** to come together and celebrate their shared heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh** is known for its **rich cultural heritage** and** wildlife sanctuaries**.

 
 
• It is home to several fairs and festivals, including the** Khajuraho Dance Festival, Tansen Music Festival, and the Chhindwara Pachmarhi festival.**
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand **is a state in eastern India known for its mineral-rich forests and diverse tribal communities.
 
 
• It hosts several fairs and festivals throughout the year, including the** Sarhul festival, Karma festival, and the Tusu festival.**
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is the most populous state in India and is known for its historical and cultural significance.
 
 
• It is home to several world-famous monuments like the **Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, and the Fatehpur Sikri.**
 
• The state also hosts several fairs and festivals, including the **Kumbh Mela, Ardh Kumbh Mela, and the Ram Navami Mela**.
